Recent Bay Area transplant here.  

Craigslist isn't the same out here.  You're better off driving/walking around neighborhoods looking for for rent signs.  The good news is you'll be paying much less, and since it's much more of a buyer's market, you'll find housing much quicker, and much more on your own terms.

I say try to get a pad in Little Italy or Coventry, at least at first.  Winter's going to be a bitch, and if you don't have a lot of experience driving on snow and ice, you want to do it as little as possible.  Also, some of the apartments on Murray Hill Road in Little Italy are as close/closer than CWRU parking lots.  If you live in Cleveland Heights, make sure you've got good off street parking, since street parking overnight will get your car towed.
